name: Plainstrider Feather
summary: On Red Cloud Mesa, young hunters gather Plainstrider Feather from the birds roaming Mulgore’s plains. Camp Narache makes clothing and tribal adornments from the feathers, honoring the creatures that provide for the village.

sections.title: A Hunter's First Offering
sections.body:
Young tauren on Red Cloud Mesa learn to track and hunt for what their tribe needs. Plainstriders roam the grassy plateau and provide food and useful feathers. Camp Narache makes garments and gear from their plumage.

Young hunters bring feathers and fresh meat to Grull Hawkwind to supply the camp. This offering is their first test. Chief Hawkwind recognizes them and welcomes them in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: What are Plainstrider Feathers used for?
faq.answer: Camp Narache makes clothing and ceremonial items from Plainstrider Feathers. Grull Hawkwind gathers them from young hunters to replenish tribal supplies.

faq.q: Who gathers Plainstrider Feathers on Red Cloud Mesa?
faq.answer: At Grull Hawkwind’s request, young hunters gather Plainstrider Feathers on Red Cloud Mesa. He replenishes Camp Narache’s stores and tests their discipline in providing for the tribe.
Plainstriders roam Red Cloud Mesa’s open grasslands and Mulgore’s rolling plains.

faq.q: Why does Grull Hawkwind require these feathers for tribal rites?
faq.answer: Hunting provides for survival and sport in tauren culture. Bringing meat and plumage to Chief Hawkwind shows a young hunter can sustain the tribe before going on to Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As a young tauren, gathering a plainstrider’s feathers teaches you to value the Earth Mother’s creatures and use each part of the kill for food and clothing.
As a hunter, stalking swift plainstriders across Red Cloud Mesa tests your patience and tracking, and teaches you to honor your quarry.
